newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NAMIBIA'S CIC HOLDINGS BUYS TONGAAT FOODS.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA'S CIC HOLDINGS BUYS TONGAAT FOODS.

text.p: Namibian group CIC Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that it had agreed to buy South African firm CPC Tongaat Foods Ltd for 16 million rand.
CIC is to own 51 percent of the group and the balance will be held by existing management and staff.
Tongaat acts as an agent for a number of grocery firms in South Africa and CIC said the move represented a significant entry into the South African distribution sector.
It added the buy would have a meaningful impact on its current financnial year.
